Definition: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of G4844; a drinking-party ("symposium"), i.e. (by extension) a room of guests:--company.
BiblicalUsage: When Jesus feeds the five thousand He commands the disciples to make them all sit down by companies upon the green grass. The word means a party or company at table, and here it turns a hungry crowd into an orderly feast, group by group, ready to be fed.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Jesus feeds His people in order, not in a scramble, and I hold that there is room at His table for every company He gathers.
RelatedEvents: The Feeding of the Five Thousand
